result.finding: Assessed 5 CWE rules in Credentials & Secrets: 0 FOUND, 5 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Specialist reviewed application configuration, upload rejection logging, deployment scripts and infrastructure. No complete hardcoded credential/key found; UserSecretsId is not a secret. MIME, size and decoder failures are logged.

Additional findings outside these five rules: infra/main.bicep:57-68,79-84 derives a predictable SQL administrator credential from non-secret metadata (CWE-1391); azure-setup.sh:197-200 emits the SQL administrator password to deployment output (CWE-532). No credential values are reproduced. These are not mislabeled as hardcoded credentials or insufficient logging.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging
values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.
